title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三十八章、那个孩子……

    大殿上，所有人都望着八王爷，希望他说出当年发生的事情。
    八王爷慢慢说道：“二十一年前的那个晚上，我和王妃正在赶路。那时王妃已经怀孕八个月了，本不应该夜行赶路，但那天晚饭时王妃收到家乡急信，说王妃的母亲病重，想见女儿最后一面，因此我才带着王妃连夜赶路回家乡。晚上十二点，经过布江时，我听到路边有孩子的哭声。我下了马车，在江边的大树下发现了一个食盒，食盒里放着一个刚出生没多久的孩子。孩子只穿了一件衣服，全身冻得发白，眼睛上方有伤口，血流了一脸。我连忙把孩子和食盒一起抱上了马车，王妃把我们为自己孩子准备的衣服给这个孩子穿上了，她抱着孩子，一刻也不愿意放手。虽然我知道这孩子出现得奇怪，但当时急着赶路，我没有停留，带着孩子往南方去了。
    “王妃的家乡离京城快马要半个月，我们行到第九天的时候，收到了家里的第二封信，王妃的母亲等不及见女儿最后一面，已经去世了。王妃受了打击，在半路上提前生产了。因为条件不好，生产过程很艰难，我们没有保住自己的孩子。虚弱的王妃回到家乡，一进家门就一病不起了，她坚持了十天，最后终于承受不住了。去世前她把那个孩子抱到我怀里，她说那是老天爷送给我们的孩子，以后她不在了，这个孩子会好好陪着我，她说这个孩子就是她和我的孩子。”
    “那个孩子……”皇帝震惊起身，但是话到嘴边又收了回去，他不是不相信，他不是需要一个答案，他只是没办法接受事实。
    八王爷悲伤地点头：“是的，那个孩子就是你。”
    皇帝的眼泪马上流了下来，他愣愣地看着八王爷，一个字也说不出了。
    “八王爷！”太后拍桌而起，厉声道：“为什么你也跟着他们一起胡说！四年前，先皇把皇上接进宫，就是因为他是你和王妃生下来的孩子，而不是从外面捡回来的没有姓名的野孩子！你必须是皇上的亲生父亲！”
    八王爷跪了下去，但他的头始终抬着：“是的，我没有告诉先皇真相，是我的错，我接受惩罚！但是，这个孩子不是没有姓名的野孩子，他本来就是先皇的亲生儿子。虽然我犯了错，但这个孩子也因为这个错而回到了先皇身边，我不后悔！”
    太后愤怒道：“真笨啊！难道你不明白吗？皇上能坐在这个龙椅上，是因为他是你的亲生儿子，如果你坚持说他不是你亲生的，那要怎么证明他是先皇的孩子？你没有证据啊！没有证据证明他是先皇的孩子，那他还能坐在这个龙椅上吗？如果皇帝的身份有问题，那全国的官员们还会听他的话吗？全国的百姓还会听他的话吗？不会啊！国家会乱啊！你想过这些吗？你负得起这个责任吗？”
fullText.traditional:
第三十八章、那個孩子……

    大殿上，所有人都望著八王爺，希望他說出當年發生的事情。
    八王爺慢慢說道：“二十一年前的那個晚上，我和王妃正在趕路。那時王妃已經懷孕八個月了，本不應該夜行趕路，但那天晚飯時王妃收到家鄉急信，說王妃的母親病重，想見女兒最後一面，因此我才帶著王妃連夜趕路回家鄉。晚上十二點，經過布江時，我聽到路邊有孩子的哭聲。我下了馬車，在江邊的大樹下發現了一個食盒，食盒裡放著一個剛出生沒多久的孩子。孩子只穿了一件衣服，全身凍得發白，眼睛上方有傷口，血流了一臉。我連忙把孩子和食盒一起抱上了馬車，王妃把我們為自己孩子準備的衣服給這個孩子穿上了，她抱著孩子，一刻也不願意放手。雖然我知道這孩子出現得奇怪，但當時急著趕路，我沒有停留，帶著孩子往南方去了。
    “王妃的家鄉離京城快馬要半個月，我們行到第九天的時候，收到了家裡的第二封信，王妃的母親等不及見女兒最後一面，已經去世了。王妃受了打擊，在半路上提前生產了。因為條件不好，生產過程很艱難，我們沒有保住自己的孩子。虛弱的王妃回到家鄉，一進家門就一病不起了，她堅持了十天，最後終於承受不住了。去世前她把那個孩子抱到我懷裡，她說那是老天爺送給我們的孩子，以後她不在了，這個孩子會好好陪著我，她說這個孩子就是她和我的孩子。”
    “那個孩子……”皇帝震驚起身，但是話到嘴邊又收了回去，他不是不相信，他不是需要一個答案，他只是沒辦法接受事實。
    八王爺悲傷地點頭：“是的，那個孩子就是你。”
    皇帝的眼淚馬上流了下來，他愣愣地看著八王爺，一個字也說不出了。
    “八王爺！”太后拍桌而起，厲聲道：“為什麼你也跟著他們一起胡說！四年前，先皇把皇上接進宮，就是因為他是你和王妃生下來的孩子，而不是從外面撿回來的沒有姓名的野孩子！你必須是皇上的親生父親！”
    八王爺跪了下去，但他的頭始終抬著：“是的，我沒有告訴先皇真相，是我的錯，我接受懲罰！但是，這個孩子不是沒有姓名的野孩子，他本來就是先皇的親生兒子。雖然我犯了錯，但這個孩子也因為這個錯而回到了先皇身邊，我不後悔！”
    太后憤怒道：“真笨啊！難道你不明白嗎？皇上能坐在這個龍椅上，是因為他是你的親生兒子，如果你堅持說他不是你親生的，那要怎麼證明他是先皇的孩子？你沒有證據啊！沒有證據證明他是先皇的孩子，那他還能坐在這個龍椅上嗎？如果皇帝的身份有問題，那全國的官員們還會聽他的話嗎？全國的百姓還會聽他的話嗎？不會啊！國家會亂啊！你想過這些嗎？你負得起這個責任嗎？”

sentences.simplified: 你必须是皇上的亲生父亲！”
sentences.traditional: 你必須是皇上的親生父親！”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bì xū shì huáng shang de qīn shēng fù qīn
sentences.english: You have to be the biological father of the emperor!”

sentences.simplified: 八王爷跪了下去，但他的头始终抬着：“是的，我没有告诉先皇真相，
sentences.traditional: 八王爺跪了下去，但他的頭始終抬著：“是的，我沒有告訴先皇真相，
sentences.pinyin: bā wáng ye guì le xià qù dàn tā de tóu shǐ zhōng tái zhe shì de wǒ méi yǒu gào su xiān huáng zhēn xiàng
sentences.english: The Eighth Prince knelt down, but he kept his head held high, “Yes, I did not tell the late emperor the truth.

sentences.simplified: 是我的错，我接受惩罚！
sentences.traditional: 是我的錯，我接受懲罰！
sentences.pinyin: shì wǒ de cuò wǒ jiē shòu chéng fá
sentences.english: It was my fault, and I accept the punishment!

sentences.simplified: 但是，这个孩子不是没有姓名的野孩子，他本来就是先皇的亲生儿子。
sentences.traditional: 但是，這個孩子不是沒有姓名的野孩子，他本來就是先皇的親生兒子。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè ge hái zi bú shì méi yǒu xìng míng de yě hái zi tā běn lái jiù shì xiān huáng de qīn shēng ér zi
sentences.english: However, this child is not a nameless, wild child. He is indeed the biological son of the late emperor.

sentences.simplified: 虽然我犯了错，但这个孩子也因为这个错而回到了先皇身边，我不后悔！”
sentences.traditional: 雖然我犯了錯，但這個孩子也因為這個錯而回到了先皇身邊，我不後悔！”
sentences.pinyin: suī rán wǒ fàn le cuò dàn zhè ge hái zi yě yīn wèi zhè ge cuò ér huí dào le xiān huáng shēn biān wǒ bú hòu huǐ
sentences.english: Although I made a mistake, this child returned to the late emperor’s side because of this mistake. I have no regrets!”

sentences.simplified: 太后愤怒道：“真笨啊！难道你不明白吗？
sentences.traditional: 太后憤怒道：“真笨啊！難道你不明白嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tài hòu fèn nù dào zhēn bèn a nán dào nǐ bù míng bai ma
sentences.english: The empress dowager said angrily, “So foolish! Do you not understand?

sentences.simplified: 皇上能坐在这个龙椅上，是因为他是你的亲生儿子，
sentences.traditional: 皇上能坐在這個龍椅上，是因為他是你的親生兒子，
sentences.pinyin: huáng shang néng zuò zài zhè ge lóng yǐ shang shì yīn wèi tā shì nǐ de qīn shēng ér zi
sentences.english: The emperor can sit on this imperial throne because he is your biological son.

sentences.simplified: 如果你坚持说他不是你亲生的，那要怎么证明他是先皇的孩子？你没有证据啊！
sentences.traditional: 如果你堅持說他不是你親生的，那要怎麼證明他是先皇的孩子？你沒有證據啊！
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ jiān chí shuō tā bú shì nǐ qīn shēng de nà yào zěn me zhèng míng tā shì xiān huáng de hái zi nǐ méi yǒu zhèng jù a
sentences.english: If you insist that he is not your biological son, how can you prove that he is the child of the late emperor? You have no evidence!

sentences.simplified: 没有证据证明他是先皇的孩子，那他还能坐在这个龙椅上吗？
sentences.traditional: 沒有證據證明他是先皇的孩子，那他還能坐在這個龍椅上嗎？
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu zhèng jù zhèng míng tā shì xiān huáng de hái zi nà tā hái néng zuò zài zhè ge lóng yǐ shang ma
sentences.english: Without evidence to prove that he is the child of the late emperor, can he still sit on this imperial throne?

sentences.simplified: 如果皇帝的身份有问题，那全国的官员们还会听他的话吗？
sentences.traditional: 如果皇帝的身份有問題，那全國的官員們還會聽他的話嗎？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ huáng dì de shēn fèn yǒu wèn tí nà quán guó de guān yuán men hái huì tīng tā de huà ma
sentences.english: If the emperor’s identity were in question, would the officials across the entire nation still listen to him?

sentences.simplified: 全国的百姓还会听他的话吗？
sentences.traditional: 全國的百姓還會聽他的話嗎？
sentences.pinyin: quán guó de bǎi xìng hái huì tīng tā de huà ma
sentences.english: Would the people across the entire nation still listen to him?

sentences.simplified: 不会啊！国家会乱啊！
sentences.traditional: 不會啊！國家會亂啊！
sentences.pinyin: bú huì a guó jiā huì luàn a
sentences.english: No, they wouldn’t! The country would fall into chaos!

sentences.simplified: 你想过这些吗？你负得起这个责任吗？”
sentences.traditional: 你想過這些嗎？你負得起這個責任嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng guò zhè xiē ma nǐ fù de qǐ zhè ge zé rèn ma
sentences.english: Have you thought about these things? Can you bear this responsibility?”

sentence_translations: Chapter 38: That Child …
In the audience hall, everyone was looking at the Eighth Prince, hoping that he would speak about what happened that year.
The Eighth Prince said slowly, “On that night twenty-one years ago, the princess consort and I were hurrying on a journey.
At that time, the princess consort was already eight months pregnant and should not have been traveling at night.
But that evening, during dinner, the princess consort received an urgent letter from her hometown.
It said that the princess consort’s mother was seriously ill and wanted to see her daughter for the last time.
That was the reason why I took the princess consort back to her hometown, traveling overnight.
At twelve o’clock at night, when we passed by the Bu River, I heard a child’s cries by the roadside.
I got off the carriage and found a food box under a big tree by the river.
Inside the food box was a child who had just been born not too long ago.
The child was only wearing one piece of clothing, and his entire body was turning pale from the cold.
There was a wound above his eye, and blood was covering his face.
I hurriedly carried the child and the food box onto the carriage.
The princess consort dressed the child in the clothes we had prepared for our own child.
She held this child and didn’t want to let go even for a moment.
Although I knew the sudden presence of the child was strange, we were in a hurry to continue our journey, ..
.. so I didn’t stop and took the child with us to the south.
“The princess consort’s hometown was half a month away from the capital by fast horse.
On the ninth day of our journey, we received a second letter from home.
The princess consort’s mother couldn’t hold on to see her daughter one last time. She had already passed away.
The princess consort was devastated and gave birth prematurely on the road.
Due to poor conditions, the labor was very difficult, and we couldn’t save our own child.
The frail princess consort returned to her hometown and fell gravely ill as soon as she entered the house.
She held on for ten days, but in the end, she could not bear it any longer.
Before she passed away, she placed the child in my arms and said that this was a child sent to us by Heaven.
After she was gone, this child would be there for me. She said this child was our child.”
“That child …” The emperor stood up in shock, but he bit back the words that were on the tip of his tongue.
It wasn’t that he didn’t believe it, and it wasn’t that he needed an answer. He just couldn’t accept this reality.
The Eighth Prince nodded sadly, “Yes, that child is you.”
The emperor’s tears immediately started to flow. He stared blankly at the Eighth Prince, unable to utter a single word.
“Eighth Prince!” The empress dowager slammed the table and stood up.
She said sternly, “Why are you also talking nonsense with them!
Four years ago, the late emperor brought the current emperor into the palace.
That was because he was the child you and the princess consort gave birth to, not some nameless, wild child picked up from outside!
You have to be the biological father of the emperor!”
The Eighth Prince knelt down, but he kept his head held high, “Yes, I did not tell the late emperor the truth.
It was my fault, and I accept the punishment!
However, this child is not a nameless, wild child. He is indeed the biological son of the late emperor.
Although I made a mistake, this child returned to the late emperor’s side because of this mistake. I have no regrets!”
The empress dowager said angrily, “So foolish! Do you not understand?
The emperor can sit on this imperial throne because he is your biological son.
If you insist that he is not your biological son, how can you prove that he is the child of the late emperor? You have no evidence!
Without evidence to prove that he is the child of the late emperor, can he still sit on this imperial throne?
If the emperor’s identity were in question, would the officials across the entire nation still listen to him?
Would the people across the entire nation still listen to him?
No, they wouldn’t! The country would fall into chaos!
Have you thought about these things? Can you bear this responsibility?”
